steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: An ore is a naturally occurring mineral from which a metal can be economically extracted

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Hydrothermal ore deposits: metal-rich hot fluids deposit minerals in veins and fractures (e.g. tin in Cornwall, gold veins)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Placer deposits: heavy minerals concentrated by river or wave action (e.g. gold, diamond placers)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Fossil fuels: coal (from Carboniferous swamp forests), petroleum (from marine microorganisms under heat and pressure)

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Ore = economically extractable mineral deposit Hydrothermal veins = cooling igneous fluids precipitate metals in fractures Petroleum system: source + reservoir + seal + trap Aquifers = porous + permeable rocks storing groundwater
